expectations.evidence: All three candidates are rephrasings of one axis (mechanism) plus one repeated rhetorical device (laptop-vs-bank parity), not three distinct framings. Primary: 'diffs your Postgres schema and writes the migration — same binary whether you run it solo on a laptop or wire it into a bank's release pipeline.' Alternate 1 is nearly identical in content: 'Diffs your Postgres schema, writes the exact migration to apply it. Install and run, or gate it in a regulated pipeline.'
